categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the design, research and development, production (through outsourcing), and sales of high-quality easy-to-install home furniture and home textile products. Main product categories include mattresses, pillows, beds, sofas, quilts, and other home furnishings. The company has recently expanded into smart home products including intelligent electric beds, smart mattresses, and smart heating blankets, with smart products now representing over 30% of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an outsourced manufacturing model rather than direct production, focusing on product design, R&D, and supply chain management. Core technologies include smart sleep monitoring, intelligent adjustment systems, voice control, and smart home integration capabilities. The company utilizes new materials research and development, with emphasis on standardization and innovation in product design. As of the report period, the company holds 274 valid patents including utility model patents, design patents, and invention patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves young middle-class consumers seeking quality sleep and home products. Key customer segments include individual consumers through B2C e-commerce platforms and B2B2C partnerships with major retailers. The company also serves distribution partners through both online and offline channels. Primary end markets include residential bedroom and living room furnishings, with growing focus on the sleep economy segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Key operating locations include branches in Ningbo and Hangzhou. The company has established subsidiaries including Ningbo Qushui Technology Co., Ltd., Hangzhou Qushui Smart Home Co., Ltd., and Qushui International Limited in Hong Kong. The company is beginning to expand internationally with plans to develop overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the home furnishings supply chain. It focuses on product design, R&D, quality control, and brand management while outsourcing manufacturing to specialized suppliers. The company directly manages sales through online e-commerce platforms and distribution channels, maintaining close relationships with suppliers and direct access to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is transitioning from a traditional home furniture company to a smart home company. Key R&D initiatives include developing intelligent sleep monitoring and adjustment technologies, smart electric beds, water-warming blankets, and AI-integrated home products. The company emphasizes innovation in new materials, smart home integration, and IoT applications. Strategic priorities include expanding smart product portfolio, improving product intelligence levels, and exploring new technologies in the home furnishings sector.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales via multiple channels: B2C e-commerce platforms (Xiaomi YouPin, Tmall, JD.com, official website), B2B2C partnerships with major retailers, and distribution through both online and offline distributors. Revenue is recognized upon customer receipt and acceptance of products, with consideration given to return policies (typically 7-21 days no-reason returns). The company also generates minor revenue from other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a technology-driven, design-focused home furnishings brand targeting young middle-class consumers. It competes with both traditional furniture manufacturers and emerging e-commerce home brands. The company differentiates through emphasis on smart technology integration, high-quality materials, standardized design, and competitive pricing. The company has established strong partnerships with major e-commerce platforms, particularly Xiaomi ecosystem, which provides significant market reach and credibility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized home furnishings manufacturer with 2023 revenue of approximately 304.86 million yuan, representing a 5.53% decline from 2022's 322.70 million yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 23.86 million yuan in 2023, down 35.32% from 36.89 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 916.35 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company has experienced revenue pressure in recent years due to challenging market conditions, though it maintains solid profitability and a strong balance sheet with substantial cash reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on providing high-quality, technology-enabled home furnishings at competitive prices with exceptional ease of installation and use. Key differentiators include: innovative smart home integration features, use of advanced materials and manufacturing techniques, standardized and user-friendly design, comprehensive after-sales service with extended return policies, and strong brand positioning in the sleep and wellness category. The company emphasizes scientific approach to sleep quality improvement and positions itself as a lifestyle brand for health-conscious consumers.
